title: CIA-created UFO news outlet appearing around the time of the Lazar film

tellings.quote: That is a CIA stood up media source.

plain: Around 2018, when his film about Bob Lazar (a man who says he worked on alien craft) came out, an online UFO news outlet run from overseas appeared, and the filmmaker Jeremy Corbell says it was "a CIA stood up media source". Corbell tells Michels this as someone who says he knows more than he can share, and if true, it would mean the CIA set up its own outlet to shape UFO coverage.
